searches.reason: Develop BERT4Rec correctness and temporal-sensitivity probes: verify reserved-mask target isolation, appended-mask inference, and final-nonpadding readout on left-padded histories; then measure ranking changes under recent-item removal, order permutation, and history truncation. Use matched random perturbations as controls, interpreting changes as model sensitivity rather than causal evidence of user preferences.
searches.query: BERT4Rec masked item prediction diagnostic tests target leakage temporal order sensitivity history perturbation sequential recommendation 2024 2025 2026

searches.reason: Translate qualitative feedback into measurable failure types: immediate choice versus deferred relevance, specific-match ranking inversions, and explicit compatibility or duplication objections. Research annotation reliability and selective evaluation so unidentified items remain unassessable rather than negative. Use only available titles, descriptions, histories, timestamps, and explicit feedback; leave ownership, compatibility, and latent preferences unknown when unsupported.
searches.query: recommender system diagnostic evaluation actionable relevance compatibility redundancy preference feedback taxonomy annotation reliability abstention missing item information

searches.reason: Replace scale-dependent margin thresholds and ambiguous collapse scores with calibrated, component-linked diagnostics. Investigate hard-negative rank errors, embedding effective rank, and representation sensitivity, with user-level uncertainty and category-specific reporting. Check whether diagnostics predict validation HR@10 failures under the fixed candidate protocol, and audit full-catalog unseen-item rankings separately without changing the evaluator or fitting additional predictors.
searches.query: sequential recommendation diagnostic probes representation effective rank hard negative ranking sampled evaluation full catalog bootstrap uncertainty metric validity 2024 2025 2026
